closes: gate G9 of V26C_J20_CRITIC_WARMUP, whose immediate half was passed and whose restore half was explicitly left owed
written_at_stage: preparation only; this document is sealed before any execution and is never rewritten
self_hash_note: this file deliberately carries no hash of itself. The runner embeds this file's sha256 as PIN_PREREG and re-hashes it at preflight, so the seal is external and cannot be forged from inside the document.

purpose.one_sentence: Reload the warm-up's checkpoint_last through the real production restore path, run ZERO new iterations, and prove that the actor, the log-std, the critic, the full module and the Adam optimizer all come back exactly as they were written.
purpose.why_a_separate_stage: The warm-up runner could not perform this. Rebuilding the algorithm and calling restore_from_path is a different action with a different blast radius, so it was preregistered as owed and the leaf was marked RESTORE_AUDIT_PENDING rather than PASS.
what_it_does_not_do: it does not train: no algo.train() call is reachable
it does not sample and does not roll out: the iteration loop range is empty by construction
it does not transplant: the warm-start branch is skipped whenever a resume path is present
it does not promote anything, does not start PPO, does not start an ex-novo run
it does not modify production code, the SEA plugin, FSM v3, the detector, the morphology, the reward, the thresholds, sigma or the architecture
it does not retry, under any outcome

lineage.operational: V26 August imitation -> J2 35D -> J8 -> J18 c13 -> J19A -> J20 critic-only warm-up
lineage.july: methodological source only, never an operational input
lineage.actor: one single 35D actor; no separate 25D, no widening, no contralateral feature

source_under_audit.read_only: this stage only reads the source leaf. Gate R11 re-hashes the whole tree before and after and fails closed on any difference.

the_command.derivation: taken from sealed_command() in v26c_j20_critic_warmup_readiness.py, the single source of the J20 invocation, and transformed by exactly three auditable operations

operation_1_substitute.why: the checkpoint under audit was produced with the critic-only config; restoring it under a different config would be auditing a different object

operation_2_remove.why: with a resume path present, train_ppo_mlp.py skips the transplant (train_ppo_mlp.py:1919, 'if args.warm_start_raw and resume_path is None'), so these tokens would be inert. They are removed anyway because leaving them would make summary.json report initialization_mode 'warm_start_raw' for a run that performed no transplant. Removing them makes the record say exactly what happened: 'resume_from'.

operation_3_append.why: this is the whole point of the stage

tokens_retained_and_why.--worker-process: makes main() fall through to run() instead of run_supervised(); a crash is a failure, never a restart
tokens_retained_and_why.--asymmetric-actor-critic: required by --freeze-actor, and it is what makes the trainer record the restored critic digest and the restored actor digest into summary.json
tokens_retained_and_why.--freeze-actor: records actor_freeze_audit[before_training] from the live restored module; with zero iterations no after_iteration entry can exist
tokens_retained_and_why.--freeze-logstd: kept identical to the run under audit
tokens_retained_and_why.--iterations 1: this is what makes the loop empty. iteration_start is derived as restored_logical_iteration + 1 = 2, so range(2, 1 + 1) = range(2, 2) has no members
tokens_retained_and_why.--checkpoint-every 1 --retain-iteration-: kept identical to the run under audit; both are reachable only from inside the loop body, so with zero iterations neither writes anything
tokens_retained_and_why.--tensorboard: kept identical; creates an empty writer directory
tokens_retained_and_why.--no-update-history: the global runs/historical_runs index must not be touched by an audit

the_command.iteration_start_is_not_passed: --iteration-start is deliberately absent so that args.iteration_start stays 0 and train_ppo_mlp.py:1755-1756 derives it from the restored checkpoint. Passing it would let this stage assert the number it is supposed to measure.

declared_side_effects.honest_statement: Building the Algorithm constructs the EnvRunners, and constructing an EnvRunner constructs its OpenSim environment; RLlib may reset an environment during setup to read its spaces. That is environment CONSTRUCTION, not sampling and not a rollout, and this preregistration declares it rather than pretending the restore is free.
declared_side_effects.what_bounds_it: no algo.train() call is reachable, so no batch is collected, no gradient is computed and no parameter is written. Gates R1, R2 and R10 measure this rather than assuming it.
declared_side_effects.cost: 13 EnvRunners plus one local runner, ray_num_cpus 14, as in the run under audit

gates.note: named R1..R12 so they are never confused with the warm-up's G1..G12. All twelve must pass; the verdict is fail-closed.
gates.R1_zero_new_iterations: train_iterations.jsonl in the audit leaf is absent or holds zero rows, AND summary.iterations_run == 0, AND summary.iterations_completed_this_process == 0
gates.R5_the_restore_path_was_taken: summary.resume_from is the audited checkpoint_last, AND summary.initialization_mode == 'resume_from', AND summary.warm_start_raw_transplant_applied_this_process is false or absent, AND no actor_transplant_report.json exists in the audit leaf
gates.R6_restored_actor_digest: summary.actor_freeze_audit holds exactly one entry, its stage is 'before_training', and its actor_digest == d4a13ff742266e9643012a27c57a6ea6b9205b030529d4c7a8af6d874ab26e96. This is the digest of the LIVE restored learner module, produced by production code, not by this runner.
gates.R7_restored_critic_digest: summary.critic_state_audit holds exactly one entry, its stage is 'before_training', and its critic_digest == 2fa9c124e7b49b679df6db35f6cd4577a70e543541feaa3e6b32bac7afa0a410, over exactly the six critic keys
gates.R8_hermetic_full_module_restore: out of process, with no Ray and no environment, the runner builds one AsymmetricActorCriticTorchRLModule at the pinned geometry, calls load_state_dict(strict=True) with the checkpoint's sixteen keys and gets empty missing/unexpected lists, and then finds every one of the sixteen tensors byte-identical to module_state.pkl. Includes the log-std slice: rows 2:4 of pi.1.weight are exactly zero and rows 2:4 of pi.1.bias are exactly -5.2983174324035645, so sigma is 0.005 on both dimensions.
gates.R9_optimizer_really_restorable: out of process, the runner rebuilds a torch Adam over the module's twelve parameters in named_parameters() order and calls load_state_dict on the pickled optimizer state after converting its numpy arrays to tensors. It must not raise; the restored state must hold exactly six entries at indices [6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11]; each entry's exp_avg and exp_avg_sq shape must equal the shape of the parameter at that index; every step must be 81; and the parameters at those six indices must be exactly the six critic tensors, which is what upgrades 'six entries at those indices' from a positional claim to an identified one. The production path must additionally have recorded an optimizer_lr_audit entry with stage 'after_restore'.
gates.R10_nothing_was_trained: the audit leaf holds no checkpoint_last, no checkpoint_best, no checkpoint_last_meta.json, no rl_module_last, no rl_module_best, no milestone_iteration_* directory, no rl_module_initial_warm_start and no actor_transplant_report.json
gates.R11_sources_unchanged: the entire source leaf tree, hashed file by file before the child starts and again after it exits, is identical; and every pinned artefact of J19A, J19B, J19C, K1, K1R1, the two configs, the overlay and the four production modules re-hashes to its pin
gates.R12_single_clean_process: exactly one child process was launched, its returncode is 0, summary.stop_reason == 'completed', summary.interrupted is false, summary.timed_out is false, no supervisor_state.json exists in the audit leaf, and no retry occurred

what_closes_G9.immediate_half_already_passed: the structural half: twelve parameters in the group, six Adam entries at indices [6..11], each with step/exp_avg/exp_avg_sq

byte_identity_definition: same dtype, same shape, same C-order bytes. Deliberately NOT numpy.array_equal, which is numeric and would treat -0.0 as equal to +0.0 and a float32 tensor as equal to its float64 copy.

protocol.no_clobber: the runner refuses to start if the destination exists
protocol.born_invalid: the leaf is created with TECHNICAL_INVALID written FIRST, before anything else, and the runner asserts that marker is the only resident before launching the child
protocol.marker_removed_last: TECHNICAL_INVALID is replaced by RESTORE_AUDIT_PASSED only after all twelve gates pass AND post-commit verification passes
protocol.post_commit_verification: every leaf-relative path named by the committed receipt is re-hashed against the receipt and against the bytes that were written, and the source leaf and all pinned artefacts are re-hashed
protocol.single_execution: one subprocess.Popen, no loop that can reach it twice, no supervisor, no retry under any outcome
protocol.go_required: --execute refuses to run without a valid architect GO whose status is not DRAFT or PROPOSED and whose closed set of pins all re-hash correctly
protocol.inert_modes: --preflight-only and --dry-run write nothing, launch nothing, and import neither torch nor ray

no modification of v26c_j20_warmup_cfg.yaml, v26c_j20_warmup_critic_only_cfg.yaml, the overlay or training_exnovo_cfg.yaml
no post-success probing of the frozen argv
